questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of creating a personal or channel brand identity for your online content?

options.text: To copy popular creators and gain quick followers
To make your content recognizable and unique so people remember and connect with your vibe
To change your style constantly to confuse your audience
To focus only on visuals without considering your personality or niche

correct_answer.text: To make your content recognizable and unique so people remember and connect with your vibe

questions.question_text: Why are thumbnails, logos, and channel art important for your online presence?

options.text: They make your profile look cluttered and hard to navigate
They act as the first impression to grab attention and reflect your brand before viewers click
They are unnecessary if your content is good enough
They should be changed daily to keep things fresh

correct_answer.text: They act as the first impression to grab attention and reflect your brand before viewers click

questions.question_text: What is a key strategy for writing effective titles, descriptions, and tags to improve visibility on platforms like YouTube or TikTok?

options.text: Use long, complicated titles to explain every detail of the video
Include catchy phrases, keywords, and calls-to-action to attract clicks and boost searchability
Avoid using hashtags or tags to keep your content exclusive
Write descriptions that are unrelated to the video to surprise viewers

correct_answer.text: Include catchy phrases, keywords, and calls-to-action to attract clicks and boost searchability

questions.question_text: How does engaging with your audience through comments, polls, and community building benefit your online presence?

options.text: It discourages followers from interacting with your content
It builds a loyal community that feels connected, increasing likes, shares, and growth
It only works if you ignore negative comments completely
It takes too much time and has no real impact on your following

correct_answer.text: It builds a loyal community that feels connected, increasing likes, shares, and growth
